title: Bound fixed-clock rank-two shortcuts on the paired BIT word
body:
## Result

The pinned 39,600-instruction BIT word has 1,557 chronological monotone paths of two rank-one MOVEs with a legal rank-two shortcut. Delete each first leg and send directly at the old second-leg clock. Keeping all other incidence and clocks fixed gives three distinct results.

- All 1,557 fail to reproduce a surviving native receipt at its required clock, even with free receiver history and generous source recoding.
- All 854 candidates with a public output at their hinge miss a required final form when all remaining ingress senders may supply their entire original preclock spans. There are 304 distinct hinge-and-ingress cuts. Each has a dual witness and adding back its deleted native row restores the target.
- Ten fail even the weaker causal ancestry condition with unlimited information sent on every remaining contact. The other 1,547 only pass that necessary test. For example, two chart-515 shortcuts disconnect input 80 from public output 191.

A concrete dual certificate at chart 525 is the difference e111 + e589. It is invisible to every remaining ingress under the native stock assumption, yet flips public output 111. An independent parser and opposite-pivot elimination recheck all 854 target witnesses, including positive and corrupted-probe controls.

## Inputs, validation and follow-up

Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. The literal source is #8027 at fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4, SHA-256 74e93daf2b7acf794ffb51f92f03f51556f68126d41ee13a8969bddb4cbe6326, retained in #8035 at ea776471bf8ed143a0625cf2d7532f65d15eb5f9. #7003 gives genuine fusions on an earlier word. #8036 gives a deeper timed proof for chart 510. This search spans the paired word and supplies a witness for each covered final-target cut.

Ran on CPython 3.12 from the pinned base:

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-paired-move-bypass-screens
```

The registered replay passed all cases, all 630 native outputs, projector nesting, comparison with full chronological replays, the low-pivot audit and corruption controls. The finite enumeration stops after the last chronological monotone pair. Retimed circuits, additional contacts, recoded exterior producers beyond the recorded spans and other multi-edge changes remain open. The smallest constructive test is to exhibit the changed source history and recover the displaced terminal in one surviving schedule. This is a scoped exclusion. It supplies no positive paid margin or new complete κ.

Ali Romman supplied the #8027 word. ToikY’s [paired-word handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19799234) identified the first chart-510 site. The retained notice credits earlier work. Clear1nsight prepared the proof and replay with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
